title: 阿爾塔風能中心
summary: 阿爾塔風能中心位於加州蒂哈查皮山口，約 600 部風機、1,548 MW，2010 年起分期建成，長期是美國最大的陸域風場；它的電力經由專為再生能源興建的 500 kV 輸電計畫送往洛杉磯。課程定量分析山口地形對風速的加速、超高壓外送的容量，以及以新機取代 1980 年代小型風機的效益。
summaryEn: Alta Wind Energy Center in Tehachapi Pass, California, about 600 turbines and 1,548 MW built in phases from 2010, was long the largest onshore wind farm in the United States, its power carried to Los Angeles by a 500 kV transmission project built for renewables. The course quantifies speed-up of wind by pass terrain, capacity of extra-high-voltage export, and the gain from replacing small turbines of the 1980s with new machines.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 山口地形上的美國大型陸域風場：地形加速、500 kV 外送與老風場的更新
v30FocusEn: A large US onshore wind farm in a mountain pass: terrain speed-up, 500 kV export and repowering of old sites

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：阿爾塔風能中心
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Alta Wind Energy Center
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「年發電量與容量因數」與「山口地形的風速加速」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annual energy and capacity factor" is correct?
options: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。
風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。
同一個地區的風速到處都差不多。
optionsEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor.
A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time.
Wind speed is much the same everywhere in one district.
quiz.explanation: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與容量因數」如何決定「阿爾塔風能中心」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual energy and capacity factor” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Alta Wind Energy Center”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：裝置容量約 1,548 MW，約 600 部風機
steps.observationEn: Project file: Installed capacity is about 1,548 MW from about 600 turbines
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與容量因數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual energy and capacity factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 年發電量與容量因數
knowledge.text: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
knowledge.textEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 裝置容量約 1,548 MW，約 600 部風機
knowledge.textEn: Installed capacity is about 1,548 MW from about 600 turbines

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與容量因數」的模型 E = P·8760·CF，風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P·8760·CF for "Annual energy and capacity factor", which value is closest to the annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)?
quiz.explanation: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 1548 MW、CFw = 0.3，得 4,068 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 1548 MW, CFw = 0.3 the result is 4,068 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與容量因數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual energy and capacity factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 1548 MW、CFw = 0.3，得 4,068 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 CFw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 1548 MW, CFw = 0.3 the result is 4,068 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise CFw by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 4,475 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 4,475 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4,068 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 CFw 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4,068 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in CFw with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 1548 MW、CFw = 0.3，得 4,068 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 1548 MW, CFw = 0.3 the result is 4,068 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 4,475 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 4,475 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual energy and capacity factor"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
輸電線是電廠蓋好之後才需要考慮的事。
以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Transmission is something to consider after the plants are built.
Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.
quiz.explanation: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與容量因數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual energy and capacity factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
knowledge.textEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
knowledge.textEn: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-1 風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-1 Wind energy generation systems – Design requirements. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「年發電量與容量因數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annual energy and capacity factor" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
同一個地區的風速到處都差不多。
optionsEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Wind speed is much the same everywhere in one district.
quiz.explanation: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年發電量與容量因數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Annual energy and capacity factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「阿爾塔風能中心」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Alta Wind Energy Center”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
knowledge.textEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1981：蒂哈查皮山口出現第一批商業風機
knowledge.textEn: 1981: The first commercial turbines appeared in Tehachapi Pass

quiz.question: 關於「山口地形的風速加速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass" is correct?
options: 同一個地區的風速到處都差不多。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
蒂哈查皮山口是內陸的莫哈維沙漠與加州中央谷地之間的缺口。
optionsEn: Wind speed is much the same everywhere in one district.
A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
Tehachapi Pass is a gap between the inland Mojave Desert and California's Central Valley.
quiz.explanation: 蒂哈查皮山口是內陸的莫哈維沙漠與加州中央谷地之間的缺口。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tehachapi Pass is a gap between the inland Mojave Desert and California's Central Valley. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 山口地形的風速加速：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「山口地形的風速加速」如何決定「阿爾塔風能中心」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Alta Wind Energy Center”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 蒂哈查皮山口是內陸的莫哈維沙漠與加州中央谷地之間的缺口。白天沙漠受熱，空氣上升形成低壓，海洋方向較冷的空氣被吸過來，全部擠過這個缺口，風速因此比周圍的平地高出許多。氣流越過山脊時，流線受到擠壓也會加速。風功率與風速的三次方成正比，風速只要高出兩成，可用的功率就增加七成以上；這就是為什麼風場的選址要精確到每一道山脊，而不是只看區域的平均風速。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tehachapi Pass is a gap between the inland Mojave Desert and California's Central Valley. By day the desert heats, rising air makes low pressure and cooler air from the ocean side is drawn through the gap all at once, so wind there is far stronger than on plains around. Flow over a ridge also speeds up as streamlines are squeezed. Wind power goes as the cube of speed, so two tenths more speed gives over seven tenths more power, which is why siting has to be exact to each ridge, not just a regional mean. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Project file: It was built in 11 phases from 2010

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind speed is much the same everywhere in one district." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 山口地形的風速加速
knowledge.titleEn: Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass
knowledge.text: 蒂哈查皮山口是內陸的莫哈維沙漠與加州中央谷地之間的缺口。白天沙漠受熱，空氣上升形成低壓，海洋方向較冷的空氣被吸過來，全部擠過這個缺口，風速因此比周圍的平地高出許多。氣流越過山脊時，流線受到擠壓也會加速。風功率與風速的三次方成正比，風速只要高出兩成，可用的功率就增加七成以上；這就是為什麼風場的選址要精確到每一道山脊，而不是只看區域的平均風速。
knowledge.textEn: Tehachapi Pass is a gap between the inland Mojave Desert and California's Central Valley. By day the desert heats, rising air makes low pressure and cooler air from the ocean side is drawn through the gap all at once, so wind there is far stronger than on plains around. Flow over a ridge also speeds up as streamlines are squeezed. Wind power goes as the cube of speed, so two tenths more speed gives over seven tenths more power, which is why siting has to be exact to each ridge, not just a regional mean.

quiz.question: 依「山口地形的風速加速」的模型 r = (1 + s)³ − 1，風速因地形加速 20% 時可用風功率的增幅最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model r = (1 + s)³ − 1 for "Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass", which value is closest to the increase in available wind power when terrain speeds wind up by 20%?
quiz.explanation: r = (1 + s)³ − 1；代入 s = 20 %，得 73 %（風速因地形加速 20% 時可用風功率的增幅）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: r = (1 + s)³ − 1; with s = 20 % the result is 73 % (increase in available wind power when terrain speeds wind up by 20%). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 山口地形的風速加速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「山口地形的風速加速」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：r = (1 + s)³ − 1；代入 s = 20 %，得 73 %（風速因地形加速 20% 時可用風功率的增幅）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 s 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: r = (1 + s)³ − 1; with s = 20 % the result is 73 % (increase in available wind power when terrain speeds wind up by 20%). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise s by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：s 增加 10% 時，結果變為 82 %（+12.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising s by 10% changes the result to 82 % (+12.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 73 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 s 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 73 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in s with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: s 增加 10% 時，結果變為 82 %（+12.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising s by 10% changes the result to 82 % (+12.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。

quiz.question: 要驗證「山口地形的風速加速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在候選山脊上設置多座測風塔與光達至少一年，並以計算流體力學模擬把量測外推到每一個機位。
風機彼此不會影響，排得越密發電量越多。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Several met masts and lidars on candidate ridges record for at least a year, and computational fluid dynamics extrapolates measurements to every turbine position.
Turbines do not affect one another, so closer packing always yields more energy.
quiz.explanation: 在候選山脊上設置多座測風塔與光達至少一年，並以計算流體力學模擬把量測外推到每一個機位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Several met masts and lidars on candidate ridges record for at least a year, and computational fluid dynamics extrapolates measurements to every turbine position. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 山口地形的風速加速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「山口地形的風速加速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-up of wind in a mountain pass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在候選山脊上設置多座測風塔與光達至少一年，並以計算流體力學模擬把量測外推到每一個機位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Several met masts and lidars on candidate ridges record for at least a year, and computational fluid dynamics extrapolates measurements to every turbine position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：複雜地形的機位要逐一做風況適用性評估，包含紊流、入流角與極端風速。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assess site suitability position by position in complex terrain, covering turbulence, inflow angle and extreme wind.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：複雜地形中氣流在山脊背風側分離，紊流強度與風切很大；風機若放在這些位置，疲勞載重遠超過設計值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In complex terrain flow separates in the lee of ridges with high turbulence and shear, and turbines sited there see fatigue loads far above design. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
複雜地形中氣流在山脊背風側分離，紊流強度與風切很大；風機若放在這些位置，疲勞載重遠超過設計值。

A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
In complex terrain flow separates in the lee of ridges with high turbulence and shear, and turbines sited there see fatigue loads far above design.
